targetReport.title: Statistical Classification of Products by Activity in the European Economic Community (CPA)
targetReport.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
targetReport.description: Established by Regulation (EC) No 451/2008. Article 1(1): 'This Regulation establishes a new common CPA within the Community in order to ensure relevance with respect to the economic reality and comparability between national, Community and international classifications and hence national, Community and international statistics.' Article 3: 'The Commission shall use the CPA for all statistics classified according to products by activity.' A six-level hierarchical structure (Article 2(1)): sections, divisions, groups, classes, categories, subcategories. CPA Version 2.2 has applied for data transmissions since 1 January 2025. One-off foundational instrument per Research.1.md §4 (a classification standard, same shape as naics/isic/anzsic already in this corpus) -- amended periodically (2.1, 2.2) but read here from its current consolidated form, not as a recast lineage with its own cadence.

targetReport.title: NACE Rev. 2 — Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Community
title_aliases: Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Community
targetReport.publisher: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
targetReport.description: The EU's statutory industry classification, established by Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006 and derived from ISIC. Every EU member state's national activity classification is built on it; Poland's PKD 2007 is the first one wired here. Minted 2026-09-11 in the Poland round — the corpus had ISIC, NAICS, ANZSIC and CPA but no NACE node at all, despite 21 EU countries in the graph.
targetReport.cadence_note: Revised about once a generation (Rev. 1 1990, Rev. 1.1 2002, Rev. 2 2006, Rev. 2.1 2023); 0.05 is that rate written as a number.

targetReport.title: Combined Nomenclature (CN)
targetReport.description: The EU's goods nomenclature for customs and external-trade statistics, built on the WCO's Harmonized System and reissued each year by a Commission Implementing Regulation under Council Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87. Minted 2026-09-11 in the Poland round; Statistics Poland groups foreign-trade goods by it.
targetReport.cadence_note: A new annual version is published each autumn for the following calendar year.
